youtube.description:
5 Kiro agent hook ideas to steal (examples)

Five Kiro hook ideas to steal today.

1. Update tests - When the agent edits code, update its tests.
2. Refresh docs - When the agent changes an API, refresh the docs.
3. Lint and format - After the agent edits, lint and format.
4. Review checklist - When the agent stops, run a review checklist.
5. Guard secrets - Before a tool runs, check for secrets.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/hooks/
